messages.subject: Nosie reduction / Filters
parts:
Dear all,

 

We made an experiment in natural environment to study sound detection, localization and propagation.

 

We installed a microphones array of 20 automatic recording units and we played a synthetic sound (mixed pure tones, with fundamental frequencies ranging from 300 to 1000 Hz).

 

We are now looking for an algorithm for noise reduction (for example median noise filter).

 

After much research, I unfortunately don’t found automated methods to reduce background noise.

I found some Matlab scripts and I would like to know if similar scripts or functions exist with Seewave or R.


I would be very grateful if you have any advice for me.

Best regards,

Morgane PAPIN
